name: fast-compact
description: Opt-in deterministic verbatim compaction: /fast-compact arms the next /compact to trim old tool outputs and bulky inputs by fixed rules instead of summarizing.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Newest messages never touched (the first message is always kept too).

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Below this character reduction, /compact falls back to the built-in summary.
